description: This source file defines the 'GetSearchContentsUseCase' class, which provides a use case for retrieving search results that are enriched with user-specific data, such as followed topics and personal news resources. It uses coroutines Flow to asynchronously combine search results and user data to produce a 'UserSearchResult'.

classes.name: GetSearchContentsUseCase
classes.description: A use case class that performs search operations and combines them with user data to produce user-specific search results.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes the search query and maps the search results to user-specific search results by combining with user data.
